title: Improve generic registry inventory readability
changes: Separate counts and byte units in generic registry, redirect and FFFF reader summaries while preserving the original validation boundaries.
validation: Compared the inventory with its immediate preimage: digit runs, headings, Markdown link targets and inline code match; text outside the selected summaries is unchanged.
limitations: The inventory language review remains partial from the actor property reader onward; historical runtime results were not reproduced and the wider English-first audit remains open.
